name: gh
description: GitHub CLI. Credentials are injected host-side from Infisical.

tools.name: gh.run
tools.description: GitHub operations: repos, issues, pull requests, CI runs. Pass the full gh argument list, e.g. "pr view 84 --json state". Arguments are passed as argv exactly as given; nothing goes through a shell. Credential-printing subcommands are refused.

args.description: the gh arguments, one argv entry per element
